razonamiento: Merged visual boxes b0 and b1 into a single Amazon Macie node because they represent the same managed discovery service acting as one logical unit (scanning source buckets and exporting findings). Maintained source S3 buckets (b2) and findings repository S3 bucket (b3) as separate nodes due to their distinct roles. Mapped MySQL (b8) to ThirdParty per rule 2 as an external data lake. Retained developer box b7 as UserCompanyDeveloper with visual evidence. All 8 drawn lines were mapped to directional edges, enriched with spoken quotes where applicable.
nombre: Sensitive Data Discovery and Analytics with Amazon Macie
